Two things need to be true at once: the extension host must be able to import shared logic from ../src/renderer (remoteUrl.ts and whatever the shared lots add next), and out/test/** must keep the exact layout the two test runners locate by path. rootDir cannot satisfy both, so the jobs are split: this file checks everything with no rootDir constraint, tsconfig.test.json emits the test tree, and esbuild (build-webview.js) produces the shipped bundles. src/webview is bundled by esbuild too and is not type-checked here.
